events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Monty Python Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic White Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped on this day in 1968. A double LP that changed music forever. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched, a true legend of rock.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound. Pure genius.

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today. His message of peace and incredible music continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, born on this day in 1947, would have been celebrating his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His influence on music, fashion and culture is immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born on this day in 1935, would have been 92.

angles.name: Happy Birthday King
angles.copy: All hail the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music still shakes the world. Thank you, thank you very much.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The guitar god who gave us some of the most iconic riffs in rock history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rocker Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Day
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking and still got that distinctive voice.

events.title: Joe Sugg turns 36
events.blurb: British YouTuber, author, and presenter Joe Sugg celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sugg
angles.copy: From YouTube sensation to Strictly star, happy 36th birthday to the brilliant Joe Sugg!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still got that blue-eyed soul magic.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, born on this day in 1946, would have been 81.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gazza
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the incomparable Gary Barlow! A true British music legend, from Take That to solo success.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Get out of our dreams and into our feed! Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean. Still making us feel good.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held on January 23, 1986.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Celebrating the legends who shaped music!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that charm and those tunes.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. An iconic moment in music history that stopped London traffic.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English musician, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins' 76th
angles.copy: Another year older for the legendary Phil Collins! Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the Genesis icon and solo superstar.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the king of British rom-coms, Hugh Grant! Still charming us on screen.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday JT
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for his birthday! Wishing a very happy 46th to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved English actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to a true national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, a legend of British television.

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash.

angles.name: The Day Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on the anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959. Their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still never gonna give him up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born on this day in 1945, would have been 82.

angles.name: Marley's Birthday
angles.copy: One love! Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His music and message resonate globally.
